faq.title: Clear answers before you start
faq.q1: How does garage account approval work?
faq.a1: When you register with 'I own a garage', your account starts in a pending state. A Veltrox administrator verifies the submission to keep the public directory trustworthy before unlocking operational garage modules.
faq.q2: How are license plates and phone numbers protected?
faq.a2: Veltrox treats license plates, VINs, and phone numbers as GDPR personal data. Access is strictly enforced server-side and in Firestore security rules so only you and garages you explicitly link can view your vehicle data.
faq.q3: Do garage customers need an account to check repair progress?
faq.a3: No. Each work order can generate a unique public status link exposing only a whitelisted summary of repair progress without requiring login or leaking personal details.
faq.q4: Can I export or permanently delete my account data?
faq.a4: Yes. Every role's Profile page includes a one-click JSON personal data export and a full GDPR account deletion workflow that purges Firestore records, uploaded files, and authentication credentials.
faq.a5: Reminders trigger automatically by date or mileage via email today, built on a clean provider interface ready for SMS and Viber channels.
faq.q6: Is Veltrox comfortable to use on a phone in the workshop?
faq.a6: Yes. Every dashboard is mobile-first with bottom navigation, high WCAG AA contrast, and large touch targets designed for mechanics on the shop floor.

legal.privacyIntro: Veltrox safeguards the personal data of car owners and garage operators in accordance with the European Union General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR — EU 2016/679).
legal.privacyS1Body: We process your name, email address, phone number, optional avatar, and vehicle identifiers including license plate numbers, VINs, mileage logs, and uploaded vehicle documents — treating license plates and phone numbers strictly as personal data.
legal.privacyS2Body: We process your data solely to deliver your digital car diary, manage work orders at garages you interact with, and send timely reminders you configure.
legal.privacyS3Body: Every record is isolated by ownerId or garageId via server-side authorization and Firestore security rules. Public repair status links expose only whitelisted status summaries and never leak phone numbers, emails, or internal notes.
legal.privacyS4Body: From your Profile page at any time, you can download a complete JSON export of your data or trigger permanent GDPR account deletion across Firestore, Storage, and Firebase Authentication.
legal.termsIntro: These Terms govern access to and use of the Veltrox web platform for car owners and automotive garages.
legal.termsS1Body: Users may register as a Car Owner (USER) or Garage Owner (GARAGE_OWNER). Garage accounts remain pending until verified by a platform administrator.
legal.termsS2Body: Users and garages are responsible for the accuracy of recorded mileage, documents, and work orders. Automated reminders assist with timely maintenance and do not replace statutory driver obligations.
legal.termsS3Body: You retain full ownership of your vehicle records, receipts, and garage data, with unrestricted export and account deletion capabilities.
